Bug_Details: Optional.ifPresent is preferred over Optional.map when the return value is unused
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by using Optional.map to transform the string to uppercase, but the result of the map operation is not used. Instead, Optional.ifPresent should be used when the return value is not needed.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUNIT test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method with both non-empty and empty Optional objects. Inside the showBug method, Optional.map is used without utilizing its result, which violates the OptionalMapUnusedValue rule.
